definition: Shockingly wrong or unacceptable according to ordinary moral standards.
author: Mark Twain
quote: The thing made a big stir in the town, too, and a good many come out flatfooted and said it was scandalous to separate the mother and the children that way.
example_sentence: The price of a coffee at the airport is scandalous.
